dispositions.resolution: Normalized Sanskrit/common planet aliases (surya, chandra, mangala, budha, guru, shukra, shani, rahu, ketu, aruna, varuna, yama) and outer planets (uranus, neptune, pluto) in solve_inverse_chart_date, rejecting unsupported constraint keys with ValueError and evaluating outer/slow planets in Stage 1.

Replaced joint 10-day point-sampling conjunction in Stage 1 of solve_inverse_chart_date with per-body conservative padded intervals (+/- step1) intersected across all constrained slow bodies so sub-10-day overlaps are never missed.
Passed use_physical_center into _calc_ut_historical_analytical and applied _PHYSICAL_CENTER_LON_OFFSET_DEG plus receipt['physical_center_applied'] on the historical fallback path.

Extended Vimshottari (years=240.0), Chara (repeated 12-sign cycles with modulo index), and Kalachakra (repeated cycle modulo total_kc_span) timelines in compute_triple_lock_life_event_convergence to cover arbitrary later-life scan dates.
Extended the upper Julian Day bound in solve_inverse_chart_date from 2816787.5 (3000-01-01) to 2817152.5 (3001-01-01) so the full year 3000 CE is searched.

Removed the unconditional analytical bypass for uranus, neptune, and pluto in EphemerisAdapter.calc_ut so full DE440/DE441 SPK kernels evaluate outer planets numerically with light-time and aberration, falling back to _calc_ut_historical_analytical only when unavailable.
Added ayanamsa parameter to generate_monthly_panchang in panchang_calendar.py and propagated ayanamsa=ayanamsa from generate_human_manual_ephemeris_compendium.

Subtracted nutation in longitude math.degrees(float(dpsi)) in propagate_yogatara_apparent before subtracting the mean-frame ayanamsa so stellar and planetary sidereal longitudes share the identical mean reference frame.
Explicitly documented the fractional antardasha month-to-day multiplier as 30 (Days = Fractional Month x 30) above Table 12B matching the 30.0 multiplier used in the table cells.
Converted Pranapada Lagna elapsed palas to degrees using elapsed_palas * 2.0 ((elapsed_palas / 15) * 30 degrees) in both compute_vishesha_lagnas_and_karakas and Table 8A of human_ephemeris.py.
Applied the Jaimini Arudha Pada Swastha exception by testing ((raw_arudha - base_sign) % 12) in (0, 6) in both vishesha_lagnas.py and Table 13A of human_ephemeris.py.
Updated Hora Lagna advancement rate to elapsed_minutes / 2.0 (0.5 deg/min = 30 deg/hr) in both vishesha_lagnas.py and Table 8A of human_ephemeris.py.

Updated the second-order quadratic interpolation correction for instantaneous velocity v_day and centered second difference Delta^2_lambda to 0.5 * (f ** 2) * Delta^2_lambda in both the worked calculation and Table 6A.
Clarified Chapter 7 LST lookup instructions relative to comp.observer_longitude_deg so the reference meridian longitude is never applied twice.
Swapped Dehamsha (seq_names[-1]) and Jeevamsha (seq_names[0]) for Apasavya rows in Table 12D to match compute_kalachakra_dasha.
Updated Air-sign Pushkara Navamsa D9 sign indices to (11, 1) (Meena and Vrishabha) in both vishesha_lagnas.py and Table 9B of human_ephemeris.py.

Computed centered finite-difference latitude speed ((pos_p1.latitude_deg - pos_m1.latitude_deg) * 0.5) and radial distance speed ((pos_p1.distance_au - pos_m1.distance_au) * 0.5) when the numerical adapter returns 0.0.
Delegated Ashtottari opening lord and birth balance in compute_all_10_parashari_nakshatra_dashas and Table 24.1 to compute_ashtottari_dasha (28-nakshatra grouping).
Used date-dependent mean obliquity eps_deg = 23.43929111 - (46.8150*t_cent + 0.00059*t_cent^2 - 0.001813*t_cent^3)/3600 in compute_topocentric_relativistic_astrometry.

Computed exact circular disk-area intersection fraction and searched observer-local daylight contact intervals around geocentric syzygy in evaluate_lifetime_eclipse_natal_sensitivity so local_visible, maximum_jd_ut, and local_obscuration_fraction reflect true local solar disk area obscuration and local eclipse timing.

Increased retrograde scan padding to 60 days (inner planets) and 180 days (outer planets) in solve_synodic_retrograde_loops_and_triple_passes so overlapping retrograde phases up to 165 days are fully bracketed.
Integrated daily sunrise/sunset compute_muhurta_windows into solve_golden_muhurta_electional_windows to penalize Rahu Kalam, Yamagandam, and Gulika Kalam and reward Abhijit Muhurta.
Fixed argument order in generate_human_manual_ephemeris_compendium when calling compute_all_10_parashari_nakshatra_dashas(moon_exact_lon, worked_houses.ascendant_deg, sun_w_lon, ...).
Normalized full cell names (_norm_sbc_name) in compute_sarvatobhadra_81_ray_vedha instead of 6-character or 4-character prefix slicing.
Dynamically scaled num_cycles in compute_all_10_parashari_nakshatra_dashas to cover query_jd across arbitrary later-life ages.
Clamped the final step in evaluate_lifetime_eclipse_natal_sensitivity to end_jd_ut so sub-4-day ranges and final partial intervals are always evaluated.
Passed physical_center=use_phys to both neighboring evaluations pos_m1 and pos_p1 in compute_full_astronomical_sky_ephemeris.
Evaluated both forward and backward roots at each shell k in _find_nearest_heliacal_crossing and returned the root with smaller abs(root_jd - jd_ut).

Padded candidate syzygy search by +/- 0.25 days around [start_jd_ut, end_jd_ut], refined syzygy via 24-step bisection, and filtered returned eclipses and natal hits strictly by start_jd_ut <= event_max_jd <= end_jd_ut; verified across all 7 assertions in test_observer_range_contracts.py.

Wrapped Kalachakra Dasha queries by the full cycle duration float(kc_dasha.paramayus_years) * float(kc_dasha.year_days) and mapped the post-timeline remainder back to kc_dasha.mahadashas[0] so later-life scans never collapse to the final mahadasha.

Added the time derivative of _planet_physical_center_offset_deg (including planet_lon_deg rate and radial distance rate) to speed_deg and is_retro on both the DE440 numerical branch and _calc_ut_historical_analytical.
Used half-open intervals c <= target_jd < c + sub_d - 1e-12 for Mahadasha and _find_sub lookups in compute_vimshottari_5_level_prana_chronometer so exact period boundaries select the incoming period.

Resolved actual sunrise cand_sr_jd via ad.rise_trans(local_midnight_ut, 'sun', 1, ...) before deciding whether t_curr precedes sunrise in solve_golden_muhurta_electional_windows, and derived vara_sun0 from sr_jd.

Replaced simultaneous daily sampling in Stage 2 of solve_chart_date_from_planetary_constraints with per-body conservative padded intervals intersected across med_bodies, and refined Stage 3 with step3 = 0.125.
Precessed icrs_dir to the true equator and equinox of date via erfa.ltp(epj) in the historical branch of propagate_yogatara_apparent before extracting ra_deg and dec_deg.

Evaluated s_nature is True or str(s_nature).lower() == 'benefic' when rendering Table 9E D60 Shashtyamsa nature labels and regenerated docs/HUMAN-READABLE-EPHEMERIS-AND-JYOTISH-ACADEMY-MANUAL.md and .html.

Recorded node_true_overrides and effective_true_node when explicit node aliases (true_node, true_rahu, true_ketu, mean_node) are passed in sign_constraints or nakshatra_constraints so ad.calc_ut and _build_inverse_match_window preserve the requested node model.
Called analytical.set_ayanamsa(ayanamsa) on the default AnalyticalEphemerisProvider in generate_monthly_panchang so non-Lahiri ayanamsa conventions are respected when no custom adapter is supplied.

Filtered active Sarvatobhadra Vedha rays by planetary motion in compute_sarvatobhadra_81_ray_vedha (all 3 rays for Sun/Moon, front+left for direct planets, front+right for retrograde planets) matching evaluate_sarvatobhadra_transits.

Replaced simultaneous 3-hour sampling in Stage 3 of solve_chart_date_from_planetary_constraints with per-body transition bisection (_bisect_match_edge) and interval intersection so short joint constraint overlaps (< 3 hours) and exact window boundaries are preserved.

Extended _make_evaluator and scan_ingresses_and_aspects in ephemeris_tables.py to accept ayanamsa and forwarded ayanamsa=ayanamsa from generate_human_manual_ephemeris_compendium so monthly ingress scans match the requested ayanamsa convention.

Added non-monotonic stationary excursion discovery in _substep_interior_sample (midpoint, 3-point quadratic station vertex, 8-subinterval bracket grid, and 12-step golden-section angular-distance minimization) so Stage 1, Stage 2, and Stage 3 preserve intervals where a body enters a sign/nakshatra around a station and turns back before the next coarse sample.

Normalized planet_longitudes_deg once via _normalize_planet_longitudes across lowercase, title-case, uppercase, and Sanskrit planet keys in compute_all_10_parashari_nakshatra_dashas and compute_nadi_amsa_and_sudarshana_chakra, and raised ValueError when required planet longitudes are missing.

Computed physical solar_elongation_deg, heliocentric distance, phase_angle_deg, illuminated_fraction_pct, and visual_magnitude in compute_full_astronomical_sky_ephemeris from full 3D spherical ecliptic coordinates (including planet and solar ecliptic latitudes) while retaining longitudinal separation for traditional Vedic combustion checks.

Included Ketu in planet_lons and called resolve_jaimini_sign_lord(base_sign, planet_lons) in compute_vishesha_lagnas_and_special_points so Scorpio (Mars/Ketu) and Aquarius (Saturn/Rahu) co-lord Arudha Padas match vargas.py::arudha_padas.

Populated Table 9A Vimshopaka Bala weights (shadvarga, saptavarga, dasavarga, shodashvarga) directly from vargas.py::VIMSHOPAKA_WEIGHTS and regenerated docs/HUMAN-READABLE-EPHEMERIS-AND-JYOTISH-ACADEMY-MANUAL.md and .html.

Computed observer-relative 3D equatorial topocentric range at both t0 and t1 (including WGS84 observer rotational position vector at local sidereal time) so radial_velocity_km_s and light_time_seconds include the surface observer's diurnal motion.

Normalized ayanamsa via _canonical_ayanamsa(str(mode or 'lahiri').strip().lower().replace('-', '_')) in both generate_human_manual_ephemeris_compendium and _render_compendium_markdown Table 1B so canonical, uppercase, space-padded, and alias spellings print offsets relative to the active ayanamsa and unsupported conventions raise explicitly instead of silently falling back to Lahiri.

Populated Table 14B Parashari Drishti columns directly from jyotish/shadbala.py::parashari_aspect_virupas() across all 36 ten-degree separation steps and regenerated docs/HUMAN-READABLE-EPHEMERIS-AND-JYOTISH-ACADEMY-MANUAL.md and .html.
